title: What Is a Dental Office Appraisal — and Do You Actually Need One?
pageTitle: Dental Office Appraisal: What It Is and When You Need One
pageDescription: A dental office appraisal has three distinct components — goodwill, equipment, and receivables. Most appraisals get the equipment component wrong. Here's what buyers, sellers, and DSO teams need to know in 2026.
